title: Insulin Pump Program Desk Guidance: Replacement Packages and Proof of Delivery
content:
The Insulin Pump Program replaces a package only on the grounds below. Every replacement ships at no charge, draws no authorized units and is never billed to a payer; it is recorded against the original shipment it replaces, and its quantity never exceeds the units of that original shipment that were lost, damaged, not received or defective.

## Grounds for a replacement

**Lost in transit.** A package is lost in transit when no proof of delivery is on file for it and the carrier trace period of business days (Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays) has passed after the carrier's expected delivery date. A package lost in transit is always replaced, expedited at no charge, and does not count toward any courtesy limit, because Larkfield bears the risk until delivery.

**Damaged in transit.** A package damaged in transit is replaced when the customer reports the damage no later than the damage report window in calendar days after the delivery date on the proof of delivery for that package, counted in calendar days from that delivery date with the last day allowed; a later damage report is not replaced.

**Delivered but not received.** A package the proof of delivery shows as delivered but the customer reports not received is replaced as a courtesy only while the program's courtesy reships over the rolling 12 months ending on the reship date are fewer than the tier's courtesy reship allowance. Those courtesy reships are the program's replacement packages sent for a delivered-but-not-received report whose ship dates fall in the 365 calendar days ending on and including the reship date being considered. Beyond that, the customer may buy the item at the cash price or wait for the next eligible refill.

**Defective as shipped.** Larkfield replaces as a product defect only supplies that were defective as shipped — the wrong item, expired product, damaged sterile packaging or a recalled lot — reported no later than the defect report window in calendar days after the delivery date. A pump that malfunctions is handled under the manufacturer warranty as a warranty exchange, never as a Larkfield product-defect replacement.

## Proof of delivery

A proof of delivery is recorded as received from the carrier, with a signature where the tier or item requires a signature on delivery, and it fixes the delivery date that return, damage and warranty windows count from; a package without a proof of delivery has no delivery date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, 7-day damage window, delivery on day D)

| Damage reported on | Replaced |
|---|---|
| day D plus 7 | Yes — the last day is allowed |
| day D plus 8 | No |

| Courtesy reships already in the 365 days ending on the reship date (allowance of 1) | Courtesy reship |
|---|---|
| 0 | Yes |
| 1 | No — the customer may buy the item at the cash price or wait for the next eligible refill |
